task: V22.0 Institutional Seven-Pillar Audit Part 1 (Pillars 1 to 4: DSR/MinTRL, CSCV PBO, ±20% Joint MC, LOYO + Block Bootstrap)

pillar1_dsr_mintrl.reason: Absolute DSR at N=100/300/600 is 1.0000 for both Champ (5Y MinTRL=37.5d<<1212d) & Pure (37.9d<<1212d) -> PASS. HOWEVER, on the incremental active spread (V22-V21, active on 117/1212 days), N=300 empirical-var DSR is 0.9400 (5Y, MinTRL=1357d>1212d) / 0.9457 (WF, MinTRL=984d>936d) for Champ and 0.9325/0.9386 for Pure (both just below 0.950; null-var DSR=0.67-0.72), while N=100 passes (0.9679).

pillar2_cscv_pbo.reason: Across K=25 unique V22/RD049/V21/V20 variants: 5Y S=10 PBO=14.29%, 5Y S=16(2k) PBO=8.10%, WF S=10 PBO=13.49%, WF S=16(2k) PBO=12.25% — ALL strictly < 20% strong-pass gate. Champ beats V21 in 98.81%..99.70% of OOS splits; Pure beats V21 in 98.41%..99.65%.

pillar3_mc_20pct.reason: Unconditional ±20% joint MC FAILS both hard gates (>=85% beat V21 WF Sharpe & >=80% MDD<=35%): MC_CORE_12 (500w): Champ beat_v21=68.0%, MDD<=35=62.6% (Pure identical 68.0%/62.6%); MC_FULL_38 (500w): Champ beat_v21=70.6%, MDD<=35=64.2%. Root cause: 100% driven by SJ114 cliff (corr=+0.793/+0.823). Multiplying 114 by -20% lowers cutoff to 91.2 (below 100 neutral baseline!), and a sharp MDD cliff hits at sj<=108 (5Y MDD jumps 29.23%->50.05%). In MC_MARGIN_12 control where SJ net margin (+14) is perturbed ±20% [111.2, 116.8] while all other 11 V22 params stay ±20%, pass rate is 100.0% beat V21 & 100.0% MDD<=32%.

pillar4_loyo_and_boot.reason: LOYO (leave out any 1 year 2021..2026): Champ & Pure beat V21 & V20 in 6/6 folds on NAV and Sharpe, with MDD<=V21 in 6/6 folds. 10,000x Moving Block Bootstrap (B=5 & B=10): Champ vs V21 P(mean>0)=99.94%/99.91% (5Y mult p05=3.40x/3.10x). Caveat: in SOLO-YEAR 2023, V22 (8.55x, SR=3.274) underperformed V21 (10.14x, SR=3.542) by -15.7%.

champion_vs_pure_verdict.reason: Pure_V21_P2_SJ114_E4_Pos5 (2 clean rules, zero 13:45 exit micro-thresholds) is statistically cleaner for live capital: Champ's +5.4% 5Y NAV edge over Pure comes from only 5 diff trades in 5 years (paired_t=0.857, p=0.3914; 0 diff in 2024 & 2026; Block-5 bootstrap mult p05=0.995<1.0; collapses to 0.9868x ex-601566). Pure also has lower CSCV win_pbo (0.0%/11.8% vs 22.8%/16.7% in 5Y). However, Champ's extra exits do not degrade MC robustness (beat Pure in 90.4%-93.4% of MC worlds).
